stock.description: Canopy SkyFire Group Limited functions as an investment holding company with a diverse portfolio. Its operations include the design, commercialization, and manufacturing of products such as two-way radios, baby monitors, and plastic goods, which are distributed across major markets including Europe, mainland China, the United States, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Australia. Complementing its manufacturing activities, the company also offers a suite of technical services, providing development and maintenance for online e-commerce platforms and supply chain SAAS systems. Furthermore, it delivers extensive consulting services to offline platforms, focusing on areas like data analysis, blockchain technology integration, and operation center management. Established in 2001 and based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, the company changed its name from Shanyu Group Holdings Company Limited to its current designation in October 2025.
